exploreUrl:
<js>
var H = 'https://cof03.bahfn.cn';

// 标签名 + onetab 编号
var TAGS = [
  ['每日最新', '61'],
  ['都市激情', '63'],
  ['校园春色', '64'],
  ['乡村爱情', '65'],
  ['系统异能', '66'],
  ['经典武侠', '67'],
  ['同人改编', '68'],
  ['科学幻想', '69'],
  ['东方玄幻', '70'],
  ['娱乐明星', '71'],
  ['历史架空', '72'],
  ['西方魔幻', '73'],
  ['贤者小说', '74']
];

var FULL = {layout_flexBasisPercent: 1};
var HALF = {layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.459};

var ui = [];

// 搜索区：输入框一行、按钮一行
ui.push({title:'关键字', type:'text', default:'', style: FULL});
ui.push({title:'🔍 搜索', type:'button', action: "var k=infoMap['关键字']; if(!k){ java.toast('请输入搜索关键字'); } else { java.searchBook(k, source); }", style: FULL});

// 标签区：一行两个
ui.push({title:'标签', url:'', style: FULL});
for (var i = 0; i < TAGS.length; i++) {
    var name = TAGS[i][0];
    var id   = TAGS[i][1];
    var u = H + '/jbapi/book/onetab/' + id + '/{{page}}/15/sort/hjm.ojbk';
    ui.push({title: name, url: u, style: HALF});
}

JSON.stringify(ui);
</js>
